scope: Line of sight on PROTOTYPE proxies (shield disk, fusion-core envelope, coast pod shields, blade planform). No emission spectrum, drive power, dose or heat load; drive waste heat stays OPEN.

rotating_pods_low_thrust.note: LOW_THRUST keeps the pods deployed while the drive runs. A point source at the core centre shadows them, but rim points of the 4.6 m core envelope see past the 5.7 m disk.

minimum_cone_for_pods.note: A shield sized only to cover the rotating pods from the core centre (no margin) would intercept this share of isotropic emission.

owner_questions: Is the shadow shield meant to cover the rotating pods during LOW_THRUST, and with what cone margin?

What share of core emission is radiated isotropically (bremsstrahlung, synchrotron, neutrons from D-D side reactions)? The shield intercepts that share times the fractions above, all of which must be rejected as heat.
Radiator blades lie almost entirely outside the shadow and see the core directly; is that acceptable for neutron activation and heating?
